title: Recent Attendance and Units Carried on a Prior Authorization Provider Change
content:
**Units ledger standard — attendance on an approval that changes servicing provider (Prior Authorization)**

**Rule.** The attendance reduction of a provider change of a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization approval counts the uses posted on the approval with service dates in the two months before the day of the change: fewer than twice the weekly frequency cap takes off 2 units; at least twice but fewer than four times the weekly frequency cap takes off 1 unit; four times the weekly frequency cap or more takes off nothing.

The uses are counted in units posted as used on this approval, by service date. The reduction is a whole number of units, taken once from the units the provider change carries over, which are never below zero.

### Thresholds by authorization class

The weekly frequency cap is the most units that may be used in one Monday-Sunday week in the class.

| Class | Weekly frequency cap | 2 units off when posted uses are fewer than | 1 unit off when posted uses are at least … and fewer than | Nothing off at |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | 0 | no count (none is fewer than 0) | no count | any count |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | 3 | 6 | 6 and 12 | 12 or more |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | 0 | no count (none is fewer than 0) | no count | any count |
| Home Health Services Authorization | 7 | 14 | 14 and 28 | 28 or more |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | 5 | 10 | 10 and 20 | 20 or more |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | 7 | 14 | 14 and 28 | 28 or more |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | 3 | 6 | 6 and 12 | 12 or more |

Where the weekly frequency cap is 0, twice and four times the cap are both 0; no count is fewer than 0, so every count reaches four times the cap and nothing is taken off.

### Hypothetical cases, for illustration only (Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization, cap 3)

- 5 units posted as used in the two months: fewer than 6, **2 units** off.
- 6 units posted: at least 6 and fewer than 12, **1 unit** off. 11 units posted: still **1 unit**.
- 12 units posted: **nothing** off.
